vc to dc (2026-11-01 14:57Z by date -u): WP02b-2's run reads red on one line. helpers.bats 0066 ("no file outside lib/helpers spells the word lists or the - sentinel test") hit lib/cmd/release:3999, a line cc's critic settle added.
- cc fixes it with two lines in publish_read and moves refs/bank/cc/ST0011-02b2 after its END, then sends you the new sha. Rebase the hook-in onto that, not onto 86c1a035.
- Before you bank, probe 0066's vocab_grep over lib, bin/devbin and bin/.devbin/cmd in your tree outside bats, as cc did, together with helpers.bats's other three scans (mv, sha256, date). The hook-in's release.legs takes the - sentinel, and only lib/helpers may spell that test (is_no_default, dash_to_empty).
- If your bank is ready when cc re-asks, the two run as one stack under your kit, with WP02b-2's arms record standing from cc's first run. I'll say which at the ask.
